question: Two pipes A and B can fill a tank completely in 5 hours and 8 hours, respectively. Pipe C can empty the tank completely in 10 hours. If all the three pipes are opened simultaneously in an empty tank, then how much time will it take to fill the tank completely?
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A can fill the tank in 5 hours.

Pipe B can fill the tank in 8 hours.

Pipe C can empty the tank in 10 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Net rate of filling = Rate of A + Rate of B - Rate of C

Time taken to fill the tank = 1 / Net rate of filling
